stripe.title: Stripe Integration
stripe.description: Connect your Stripe account to Helicone using a Restricted Access Key
stripe.howToTitle: How to get your Stripe Restricted Access Key
stripe.step1: Go to your Stripe Dashboard and navigate to Developers → API keys
stripe.step3: Give your key a descriptive name like "Helicone Integration"
stripe.step6: Copy the key (it starts with "rk_live_" or "rk_test_") and paste it below
stripe.note: Note: Use a test key (rk_test_) for development and a live key (rk_live_) for production.
stripe.eventNameHint: The event name to use when sending data to Stripe
stripe.testMeterEventsHint: Test your meter event configuration without saving
stripe.testEventHint: This will send a test meter event to Stripe using your current settings
stripe.saveFirstToTest: Please save your configuration first to test
stripe.nextStepsIntro: After saving your configuration, add the following header to your Helicone requests to track usage in Stripe:
stripe.nextStepsReplace: Replace cus_12345678 with your actual Stripe customer ID. This will link your Helicone usage to the correct Stripe customer for billing.
stripe.rakHint: Your key is encrypted and stored securely
